title: fritap.events/1 stream record
description: One line of the `fritap -j -` JSONL event stream (friTap/output/stdout_stream.py, friTap/output/jsonl_stdout_handler.py). The stream starts with a `stream_start` record and ends with `stream_end` (or with a single `usage_error` record). Event kinds are open: `type` is the snake_case of the event class (minus `Event`), so unknown types must be tolerated. `bytes` values are hex-encoded. Records are open objects: an event carries all fields of its event class.

schema.description: Schema/version marker carried by every line; bumped on incompatible changes.

type.description: Record kind. Envelope records: `stream_start`, `stream_end`, `usage_error`, and the closing runtime `error` record (no `event` field). Event kinds: `keylog`, `data`, `session`, `library`, `console`, `error`, `detach` (explicit names) and the snake_case of any other event class, e.g. `instrument`, `platform_report`, `script_loaded`, `socket_trace`, `ohttp`, `message`, `anti_tamper_detected`, `live_ready`.

timestamp.description: Epoch seconds. Envelope records get the write time; event records keep the event's own timestamp.

event.description: Event class name (e.g. `KeylogEvent`). Present on every event record; absent on envelope records (`stream_start`, `stream_end`, `usage_error`, closing runtime `error`).

event_type.description: Present on every event record (alongside `event`); absent on envelope records. Inherited from the file JSONL record: the event class name, except for `session` records where it is the SessionEvent's own `event_type` field (e.g. `started`).

protocol.description: Protocol of the event (e.g. `tls`, `ssh`, `mtproto`). Present on event records.

exit_code.description: Process exit status: 0 ok, 1 runtime error, 2 usage error, 3 target detached, 128+signum for a non-SIGINT signal.

key_material.description: True when keylog records carry the secret (`-k` or `--json-keys`); false when they are redacted.

stream_end.description: Last line of a normally closed stream.

exit_code.description: Final exit status; null when it is not known.

ended_by.description: Why the run ended: `duration` (--duration timer), `stopped` (stop signal / Ctrl+C), `target_exited` (exit code 3), `error` (runtime failure). Omitted when the reason is unknown.

usage_error.description: The only line of a stream that failed argument parsing (no stream_start/stream_end).

runtime_error.description: Closing runtime-error record written right before stream_end of a failed run. Carries no `event` field.

hint.description: Only present when friTap has a concrete next step.

keylog_redacted.description: Keylog record without key material (default policy). Secret fields are removed.

label.description: Keylog label, or `unknown` when the line carried no recognisable label. Absent when the record had no key_data (e.g. a payload-only SSH record).

client_random.description: Public client_random; only present for a genuine NSS keylog line. `???` when the agent could not read it (the label is still set).

keylog_with_key_material.description: Keylog record carrying the secret (only with `-k` or `--json-keys`).

key_data.description: Pre-formatted keylog line (may be empty when `payload` is used).

payload.description: Structured key material, e.g. an SSH KEX shared secret.

endpoints_synthetic.description: True when the socket tuple is a synthetic 198.18.0.0/15 one (fd-less TLS record), not a real address.
